column1: # Rows db.phi.* (line PS, item PS8a, 2026-11-23): psiblast -phi_pattern with one round (PHI-BLAST), frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; the pattern files are tests/fixtures/phi/*.pat

column12: covers
PS8a: outfmt 0: the pattern block, one description table and one alignment section per occurrence with the pattern row (label width 7)
PS8a: outfmt 6: the rows of each occurrence in turn
PS8a: outfmt 7: a full header per occurrence (# PHIBLASTP, # Iteration: 1) and # BLAST processed 0 queries
PS8a: outfmt 10 with fields, per occurrence
PS8a: outfmt 20: the field names once, then each occurrence's rows

column12: PS8a: a custom field list that reads the alignments, per occurrence
PS8a: an occurrence without alignments after one with: its empty table header and section
PS8a: stars over gap columns of the pattern row
PS8a: a two-letter pattern with many occurrences
PS8a: the first occurrence without alignments: No hits found and the PHI footer
PS8a: -query_loc: positions in the range, the pattern row drawn at them (none on the alignment)
PS8a: a pattern not in the query: NCBI's engine error after the prolog (rc 3)
PS8a: outfmt 8: NCBI's engine error Program type 'phiblastp' not supported (rc 3)
PS8a: -subject in place of -db: the subjects' ids and the footer of a subject search
PS8a: -subject with the query itself: the self hit at each place
PS8a: a query with O: its message on the report's output before Results from round 1 (not on standard error)
PS8a: a query with O in outfmt 7: the message once, before the first occurrence's header
PS8a: a matrix without NCBI's PHI statistics: NCBI's message, no pattern block, No hits found and -1 Karlin blocks with a search space of 0
PS8a: the same in outfmt 7: the message, then a header without a line of hits found
PS8a: the same in outfmt 20: the field names, then the message
PS8a: gap costs without NCBI's PHI statistics: NCBI's message of the combination
PS8a: outfmt 8 without NCBI's PHI statistics: no output and exit status 0 (no alignment to refuse)
PS8a: -num_iterations 3 without NCBI's PHI statistics: round 1 is the last, as with -num_iterations 1
PS8a: -sum_stats true without NCBI's PHI statistics: nothing is searched
PS8a: NCBI's PHI table compares the matrix name as given: -matrix blosum62 has no statistics (Matrix blosum62 not allowed in PHI-BLAST) and nothing is searched
